sqlMap.select: SELECT T.PA_BEN_BASE_SEQ, GET_DEPT_NAME(D.DEPTNO,'zh') DEPTNAME, E.EMPID, E.LOCAL_NAME CHINESENAME, CHANGER_IDNO(P.IDCARD_NO) IDCARD_NO, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(P.REG_TYPE_CODE,'zh') AS REG_TYPE_CODE_NAME, C1.CONTENT AS POST_COEF_NAME, C2.CONTENT AS STATUS_CODE_NAME, TO_CHAR(E.DATE_STARTED,'yyyy-mm-dd') AS DATE_STARTED1, TO_CHAR(E.DATE_STARTED,'yyyy-mm-dd') AS DATE_STARTED, TO_CHAR(E.DATE_LEFT,'yyyy-mm-dd') AS DATE_LEFT, CHANGER_IDNO(T.SOCIAL_NO) SOCIAL_NO, T.PAY_SALARY, T.AVG_SALARY, T.IMP_TYPE, T.DATE_TYPE, T.ERROR_REMARK FROM PA_BEN_BASE T, HR_EMPLOYEE E, HR_PERSONAL_INFO P, HR_DEPARTMENT D, SY_GLOBAL_NAME C1, SY_GLOBAL_NAME C2 WHERE T.EMPID = E.EMPID AND E.PERSON_ID = P.PERSON_ID(+) AND E.DEPTNO = D.DEPTNO(+) AND E.POST_NO = C1.NO(+) AND E.STATUS_CODE =C2.NO(+) and c1.LANGUAGE='zh' and c2.LANGUAGE='zh' and e.cpny_id='C02' $order$
SELECT T.TYPE, S.CONTENT, T.VALUE FROM T_PA_BENHS_CHECK T, SY_GLOBAL_NAME S WHERE T.TYPE = S.NO ORDER BY T.TYPE
sqlMap.update: UPDATE PA_BEN_BASE SET ALLOW_UPDATE = '' WHERE ALLOW_UPDATE = 'Y'
sqlMap.delete: DELETE FROM PA_BENHS_BASE T WHERE T.IMP_TYPE = 'N'
sqlMap.select: SELECT count(*) FROM PA_BEN_BASE T, HR_EMPLOYEE E, HR_PERSONAL_INFO P, HR_DEPARTMENT D, SY_GLOBAL_NAME C1, SY_GLOBAL_NAME C2 WHERE T.EMPID = E.EMPID AND E.PERSON_ID = P.PERSON_ID(+) AND E.DEPTNO = D.DEPTNO(+) AND E.POST_NO = C1.NO(+) AND E.STATUS_CODE =C2.NO(+) and c1.LANGUAGE='zh' and c2.LANGUAGE='zh' and e.cpny_id='C02'
sqlMap.delete: DELETE FROM PA_BEN_BASE T WHERE T.PA_BEN_BASE_SEQ=#id#
sqlMap.update: UPDATE PA_BEN_BASE SET ALLOW_UPDATE = 'Y' WHERE PA_BEN_BASE_SEQ in ( $ids$ )
sqlMap.select: SELECT GET_DEPT_NAME(D.DEPTNO,'zh') DEPTNAME, e.Person_Id, e.empid EMPID, E.Local_Name CHINESENAME, P.IDCARD_NO, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(P.REG_TYPE_CODE,'zh') AS REG_TYPE_CODE_NAME, C1.Content AS POST_COEF_NAME, C2.Content AS STATUS_CODE_NAME, to_char(E.DATE_STARTED, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AS DATE_STARTED1, to_char(E.DATE_STARTED,'yyyy-mm-dd') AS DATE_STARTED, to_char(E.DATE_LEFT, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AS DATE_LEFT, T.SOCIAL_NO, T.PAY_SALARY, T.AVG_SALARY, T.IMP_TYPE, T.DATE_TYPE, T.ERROR_REMARK FROM PA_BENHS_BASE T, HR_EMPLOYEE E, HR_PERSONAL_INFO P, HR_DEPARTMENT D, sy_global_name C1, sy_global_name C2 WHERE T.Person_Id = E.Person_Id AND E.Person_Id = P.Person_Id(+) AND E.DEPTNO = D.DEPTNO AND E.POST_NO = C1.NO(+) AND E.STATUS_CODE = C2.NO(+) AND T.ALLOW_UPDATE = 'Y' and c1.LANGUAGE='zh' and c2.LANGUAGE='zh' ORDER BY E.DEPTNO, T.Person_Id ASC
sqlMap.update: UPDATE PA_BEN_BASE SET AVG_SALARY = #avgSalary#, ALLOW_UPDATE = '' WHERE PERSON_ID = #empID#
